expressions.cue: A shop takes 20% off the regular price. Express the discount using 割引; a final き is optional. Give the reduction rate, not the percentage left to pay.
expressions.explanation: One 割 is one tenth, so 二割引 deducts 20% of the regular price. With no other charges, 80% remains to pay. This expression gives a reduction rate, not a price in yen.
